text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. Secretary of State Albright sends two letters to Prime Minister Kabariti praising King Hussein's role in supporting Middle East peace process.
- Senior PLO official Faisal al-Husseini expected in Amman on Monday for talks with Jordanian officials.
- Minister for Municipal Affairs Tbeishat says ministries ready for local elections on February 26.
- Kabariti follows up efforts to check condition of Jordanians in Kuwaiti jails.
- Jordanian hotel executive returns home with his family to Amman after being detained in Lebanon for three weeks.
- Kabariti asked in parliament about government cars granted to journalists and writers.
- Panel being set up to campaign for release of Jordanians held in Kuwait.
